title: Resolve dynamic HDR MKV video track IDs
summary: Added a fail-closed Dynamic HDR MKV video track-id resolver that uses mkvmerge JSON evidence and ffprobe stream-index mapping before extraction planning consumes a track id.
reason: Dynamic HDR MKV extraction requires an explicit MKVToolNix video track id. The planner already rejects implicit track-0 assumptions, so Do-Encode needs a tested resolver before extraction/injection can be safely wired.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR extraction planning accepted an explicit VideoTrackId for MKV inputs but there was no Dynamic HDR-owned resolver to map ffprobe video stream evidence to an MKVToolNix track id.
behavior_after: Resolve-DynamicHdrMkvVideoTrackId runs mkvmerge -J, records candidate track evidence, resolves by properties.number - 1 when an ffprobe stream index is available, accepts a single video track fallback, and fails closed with DYNAMIC_HDR_VIDEO_TRACK_UNRESOLVED when mapping is ambiguous, unmatched, malformed, or mkvmerge fails.
tests_added: ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 covers single-track resolution, ffprobe-index mapping across multiple video tracks, ambiguous multiple tracks, unmatched ffprobe indexes, and mkvmerge failure evidence.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to remove Resolve-DynamicHdrMkvVideoTrackId, its integer helper, unit coverage, generated summaries, and Dynamic HDR status wording; no runtime state or media files are changed.
notes:
